description: This Java interface defines a behavior for modifying the configuration of an Akka actor, including a default method that handles the ModifyConfig message by updating the actor's config and responding with a ModifyConfigResponse.

classes.name: ModifyConfigBehavior
classes.description: An interface extending Actor that provides a default method to define a behavior handling ModifyConfig messages, updating the actor's config accordingly.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Abstract method to update the actor's configuration, returning the new config.

methods.name: modifyConfigBehavior
methods.description: Default method that creates a receive behavior handling ModifyConfig messages by updating the actor's config and sending a response.
